structure.unit: Provisions Relating to Accident and Sickness Insurance
Jurisdiction Over Providers of Health Care Services

law.catch_line: Disclosure of extent and elements of coverage

text.section: Any agent, agency, administrator, or other person that advertises, sells, transacts, or administers coverage for health care services in this Commonwealth where that coverage is provided by any person subject to the provisions of this article shall inform any purchaser, prospective purchaser, or covered person of (i) the lack of insurance or other coverage, unless that coverage is fully insured or otherwise fully covered by an admitted life insurer, accident and sickness insurer, health services plan, dental or optometric services plan, or health maintenance organization and (ii) if the coverage is fully insured or otherwise fully covered, the terms, coverages, limits, and deductibles including the amount of "stop-loss" insurance in effect.
